# Resume bullets (generated by forecast/write_summary.py)

- Forecasted daily NYC 311 request volume 14 days ahead with gradient boosting (calendar, federal-holiday and lag features), reducing MAE 16.5% vs. a seasonal-naive baseline on 9 validation windows and 6.0% on 9 held-out rolling-origin test windows; documented that a 4-week same-weekday average did better on the volatile test period (18.3%).
- Built leakage-free forecasts for NYC's 5 busiest 311 agencies and turned 80% prediction intervals into P90 staffing plans, cutting backtested short-staffed days from 37-52% to 13-20%; found a single-location filing burst (124,099 requests) whose removal cut outlier days from 29 to 11.
